swap_observation.wall_time_method_and_limit: Receipt timestamp minus final memory-sample elapsed plus event elapsed; approximate because receipt write time is after sampling, not a timestamp recorded at the event.
swap_observation.attribution: Host-global counters do not identify the responsible process or cgroup. No causal attribution to Qwen or another workload is made.

archived_sysstat.scope_and_limits: Historical system-wide PSI columns all display0.00 at these ten-minute samples. Display rounding and sparse sampling cannot prove zero subsecond stalls; the archive here does not identify the process causing the44-page event. Paging includes direct reclaim during the23:00-23:10 interval.

post_run_oom_and_pressure.scope_and_limits: Current boot/user-cgroup cumulative OOM counters are not per-request telemetry. Current PSI is after shutdown and is not historical evidence. Worker VmSwap and fine-grained PSI were not captured by the original test.

decision.capacity_and_response_result: The original four240K run provides passed functional, token-capacity and concurrency evidence; it does not retroactively pass its declared strict-zero-swap rule.
decision.engineering_recommendation: Treat nonzero host-global swap counts alone as diagnostic, not sufficient evidence of model-serving memory failure. Do not rerun the45-minute test merely to seek a zero host counter. Complete the already-required real Hermes tests under the preregistered monitored criteria below, retaining this independent review and original failure.
decision.no_attribution_or_guarantee: The176KiB event is consistent with a negligible shared-host paging event, but its cause is unknown. This review does not guarantee unlimited24/7 stability.

preregistered_followup.workload: Four actual Hermes research/coding sessions with Qwen resident alongside SparkFast; collect before, during and after data in the continuation wrapper.
preregistered_followup.memory_psi_fraction_definition: Delta of PSI full total microseconds divided by elapsed monotonic microseconds, measured from before through after the complete observation; record both host and worker cgroup and require each<=0.01. Also retain intermediate samples and maximum window values for review.
collection_requirements: Pin worker PID and cgroup identity; fail if it changes or telemetry is unreadable.
Sample MemAvailable, worker VmSwap, host/cgroup PSI full totals, host oom_kill and worker memory.events; take before and after baselines.
Retain host pswpin/pswpout and measured rates; abort on existing sustained swap-out guard.
Require actual Hermes task correctness/tool completion plus SparkFast health and a bounded responsiveness check.
Do not rewrite historical receipts or describe the old strict-zero check as passed.
preregistered_followup.policy_status: New operator-selected engineering criteria declared before the follow-up, not Linux-prescribed universal safety thresholds.

privacy: Contains model/runtime paths, aggregate counts, timestamps and system telemetry only; no prompts, responses, credentials or personal session identifiers.
